# `carts` — module reference

Rendered from the module's own manifest, and from nothing written by hand. What the module *does* is [its own page](../modules/carts.md).

## Activation

**This module cannot be switched off.** The basket every ordering path assembles — checkout, quick order and the quote flow all go through it.
